statements.text: Public GitHub re-read at source: (1) commit 93bab2a6 (git author date 2026-11-24T18:28:43Z, actor recovery-steward) titled 'Test disabled and limited-budget fixtures without requiring live offices to remain disabled', changing five tests/knowledge-*-smoke.sh fixture files; (2) commit 5f307a49 (2026-11-24T18:32:36Z, actor recovery-steward) titled 'Repair activation delayed native-session binding in knowledge budget' whose message states that no hash-bound Act34 file, config, permit or cap changed and there was no live dispatch, changing government/knowledge-budget.sh, a records/knowledge note and a test; (3) commit ed312294 (2026-11-24T18:46:57Z, GitHub login ottojung, git author Otto Jung) titled 'Restore continuous Executive research staffing and reusable proof search', changing 22 files under government/ and missions/pnp/. These are directly re-read statements about what the public commit metadata and changed-file lists say; commit messages are git-author claims, not independently verified system state, and all three commits are the Town's own mirrored public activity.

Cross-channel inference update (no authority, confidence held at 0.86): the public record contains, one minute before the Founder's 18:29Z board message, a commit whose message and changed-file list match the activation-smoke-fixture defect that message described, plus a follow-up commit reaffirming that no permit control changed and there was no live dispatch. This is consistent with the delivery-problem reading and weakens a preference-shift or waiver reading, but it is a correlated, same-project source and is therefore NOT independent corroboration; confidence is intentionally unchanged. Commit messages are author claims, not verified system state, and no Founder instruction, authorization, ballot, spending or new scope arises here. Falsifiers: a later primary message waiving the independent after-start review or the board-approval requirement, or primary evidence that the four offices were already live with independently checked outcomes at the relevant time.
